name: scenario_0658
description: The user is compiling a marketing strategy note by cross-referencing existing plans with new data from various infographics, setting reminders, and coordinating with their marketing team. (UI mode)

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Please create a new note called 'Marketing Strategy' and add 'Target Markets: Germany, Canada, Japan' to it.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to create a new note titled 'Marketing Strategy' with the initial text 'Target Markets: Germany, Canada, Japan'. Confirm once the note is successfully created.

ROUND 2
Query: Set a reminder for next Monday at 9 AM to review that Marketing Strategy note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to set a reminder for next Monday at 9:00 AM to review the note you just created. Once the reminder is set, move to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Look at the first image and find the top 5 countries for social media jobs. Cross-reference them with my Target Markets in the note and add any that are missing. Also, look at the second image, find the #10 brand leader, which is Microsoft, and add them to the note as a competitor to study.
Instructions: Share the two infographics. Ask the assistant to check your 'Marketing Strategy' note, compare your target markets with the top 5 countries for social media jobs in the first image, and add the missing ones to the note. Also, ask it to add the number 10 brand leader from the second image as a competitor to study, but intentionally misidentify it by telling the assistant that the number 10 brand is Microsoft. Let the assistant respond; if it corrects you, acknowledge it in the next turn.

ROUND 4
Query: Oops, I misread the chart. You're right, Microsoft is actually #11. Please add FedEx as the #10 brand to the note instead.
Instructions: Acknowledge the mistake about the brand ranking (whether the assistant caught it or not). Tell the assistant to add the actual number 10 brand leader to the note as a competitor instead. Confirm when the note has been successfully updated.

ROUND 5 [provide: image_3, image_4]
Query: Here are two more infographics. I want to promote the website listed at the bottom of this bodybuilding infographic. Look at the social media stats infographic and tell me the monthly active user numbers for each platform — I'll decide which one to advertise on.
Instructions: Share the final two infographics. Ask the assistant to find the website at the bottom of the bodybuilding image, and to read the monthly active user counts for each social media platform from the statistics image. When the assistant presents the platform data, select the platform with the highest number of monthly active users and tell the assistant to send an email to marketing@fitness.com instructing them to run ads for the website on that platform. Use `ui_user_interact` to select the platform. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to use the platform with the highest MAU. Conclude the conversation once the email is sent.

You have 4 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0,1' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 5: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2,3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
Please create a new note called 'Marketing Strategy' and add 'Target Markets: Germany, Canada, Japan' to it.
